**VP of Software Engineering** 




**Location:** 

 Riyadh
 




**Level:** 

 Executive / VP
 




  





**Company Description** 
 Solidrange is a cybersecurity company based in Riyadh focused on building modern platforms to address cybersecurity and enterprise Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) challenges. The company aims to transform the GRC technology landscape so organizations can modernize their practices and lower operational overhead. Solidrange’s mission is to reduce human\-driven cybersecurity risks, simplify compliance and risk management, and support seamless business continuity. Team members work on solutions that directly impact how enterprises protect their assets and maintain resilience in a rapidly evolving threat environment. This is an opportunity to contribute to a high\-impact domain at the intersection of cybersecurity, technology, and business operations.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Vice President of Software Engineering is a full\-time, hybrid role based in Riyadh, with flexibility for some work from home. This role leads the engineering organization, setting technical direction, defining best practices, and ensuring delivery of secure, scalable, and reliable cybersecurity and GRC platforms. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include overseeing software development teams, collaborating with product management on roadmaps and priorities, and working with architecture leaders to define system design and technology standards. The VP will drive engineering execution, improve development processes, and establish metrics for quality, performance, and security. The role also involves partnering with executive leadership on IT strategy, resource planning, and budget, mentoring engineering leaders, and fostering an inclusive, high\-performing culture aligned with Solidrange’s mission.
 



  





**Role Overview** 





 We are need a VP of Engineering who is first and foremost a deeply experienced software engineer someone who has spent years in the trenches building production systems and only then stepped into leadership. You still write code, review PRs with substance, and can out\-architect any problem on the board. The title is VP, but the mindset is Senior Engineer who leads.
 








**What You'll Own** 




 ·       
 
 Actively contribute to architecture, code reviews, and critical implementation decisions across .NET, Angular, FastAPI, Django and Python stacks
 




 ·       
 
 Lead the design and hands\-on delivery of AI capabilities: LLM integrations, agentic workflows, and RAG pipelines built into product features
 




 ·       
 
 Own the technical roadmap alongside Product, translating business requirements into concrete, implementable engineering plans
 




 ·       
 
 Set engineering standards from a place of experience code quality, CI/CD, security patterns, testing discipline and model them yourself
 




 ·       
 
 Mentor and grow engineers across the team; your technical depth is what makes your feedback actionable
 




 ·       
 
 Own reliability and scalability of enterprise\-grade production systems , SLAs and uptime are your problem too, not just ops
 




 ·       
 
 Make fast, well\-reasoned build\-vs\-buy and architectural trade\-off decisions without needing a committee
 




 ·       
 
 Report to the executive team on engineering health with the credibility of someone who knows the codebase firsthand
 








**Technical Leadership** 




**Architecture \& Systems Design** 




 ·       
 
 You have personally designed and shipped distributed systems, multi\-tenant SaaS architectures, and enterprise integration patterns.
 




 ·       
 
 Deeply comfortable across the full stack: .NET/C\# backend services, Python/FastAPI microservices, Angular frontends, and cloud infrastructure
 




 ·       
 
 You prototype to validate, write code to unblock, and review PRs with the depth to catch what automated tools miss
 




**AI \& Intelligent Systems** 




 ·       
 
 You have built and shipped production AI features yourself LLM orchestration, RAG pipelines, agentic tool\-use patterns.
 




 ·       
 
 Can evaluate AI approaches for feasibility, latency, cost, and risk from implementation experience, not theory
 




 ·       
 
 Understands the operational and compliance requirements of AI in enterprise environments: audit trails, explainability, data residency, prompt security
 




**Enterprise Platform Engineering** 




 ·       
 
 Proven track record maintaining and scaling enterprise SaaS products with demanding availability and security requirements
 




 ·       
 
 Fluent in cloud\-native patterns (Azure preferred), DevOps pipelines, containerization, and platform observability
 




 ·       
 
 Experience with GRC or BCM domains, or adjacent regulated/compliance\-heavy industries, is a strong advantage
 








**What We're Looking For** 




 ·       
 
 12\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience ,the majority of your career has been spent writing and architecting code, not managing it from a distance
 




 ·       
 
 Actively coding or architecting within the last 2 years; we will ask about recent technical work in the interview process
 




 ·       
 
 Deep, production\-proven experience in at least two of: .NET/C\#, Python/FastAPI, Angular with working familiarity across all of them
 




 ·       
 
 Shipped AI features to production: LLM integrations, RAG pipelines, or agentic systems built on frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent
 




 ·       
 
 Strong grasp of enterprise software requirements: multi\-tenancy, RBAC, SSO/SAML, audit logging, data isolation, and compliance controls
 




 ·       
 
 Leadership experience that grew naturally from technical credibility
 




 ·       
 
 Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent
 




**Education** 




 ·       
 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a closely related field is required
 




 ·       
 
 Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, with a strong technical focus is preferred
 




 ·       
 
 Relevant certifications are a plus: Microsoft Azure (AZ\-204, AZ\-305, AZ\-400\), AWS Solutions Architect, Google Cloud Professional, or AI/ML certifications (e.g.
 
 DeepLearning.AI
 
 , Coursera ML Specialization)
 








**Nice to Have** 




 ·       
 
 Experience in BCM, GRC, risk management, or adjacent compliance\-driven SaaS verticals
 




 ·

data.jd_text:
**Investment Director \- Doha, Qatar** 




**The platform** 
 A Doha based alternative investment platform. This vertical is a six\-person investment team spanning education (GCC), infrastructure and secondaries (both global), plus opportunistic deals in other sectors.
 



  





 The teams strategy combines direct minority equity and co\-investments alongside leading global sponsors, with target deployment of c.$1bn per annum across the team.
 



  





 The portfolio shows both breadth and sponsor quality:
 


* **Direct:** 
 a GCC K\-12 schools portfolio and a global lifestyle hospitality platform.
* **Co\-investments:** 
 a global branded consumer business, a US mid\-market alternative asset manager, and a premium European education group.
* **Secondaries / continuation vehicles:** 
 core infrastructure including a major UK airport and a global subsea telecoms network.



  





**The role** 
 A senior, mandate\-shaping hire to lead the firm's education investing, focused on the GCC and building on an established K\-12 schools platform. The Director will own education deals end\-to\-end while contributing to the team's wider direct and co\-investment activity, operating with significant autonomy alongside senior leadership and external sponsors.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 



* Originate and screen GCC education opportunities, with a focus on K\-12 and premium/international schools.
* Execute deals end\-to\-end: modelling, valuation, due diligence, structuring, negotiation and documentation.
* Structure direct minority equity and co\-investments alongside global sponsors.
* Prepare and present investment committee materials.
* Steward portfolio assets: board engagement, performance monitoring, value creation and exit.
* Support the team's wider direct, co\-investment and secondaries activity across infrastructure and other sectors.



  





**Requirements** 



* Director / Principal\-level investment experience from a PE firm, infrastructure or real\-assets fund, sovereign or institutional investor, or sector\-focused education investor.
* Education\-sector experience, ideally schools platforms (K\-12 / international / premium); GCC or emerging\-markets exposure advantageous.
* Strong end\-to\-end execution across direct equity and co\-investments, including structuring and negotiation.
* Excellent commercial judgement, with the ability to lead diligence and present to an IC.
* Relationships across the education ecosystem (sponsors, operators, advisors) a strong plus.
* Familiarity with Shari'a\-compliant structures beneficial but not essential; English fluency required, Arabic an advantage.



  





**Location** 
 Doha, Qatar. Relocation support available.

( 20140 )
   

  

 Atlantis Dubai is part of Kerzner International, and home to two extraordinary resorts: the world\-renowned Atlantis, The Palm and the ultra\-luxury Atlantis The Royal. Together, they represent world\-class service, bold innovation, and unforgettable experiences brought to life.
   

  

 With over 6,000 colleagues from 129 nationalities, Atlantis Dubai operates as one team, with many departments and back\-of\-house functions seamlessly supporting both resorts. Across every role and department, our shared purpose is the same: to create amazing experiences and everlasting memories \- not only for our guests, but for our colleagues too.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Reporting to the Vice President of Information Technology, you will define and execute our data and AI strategy, ensuring that our platforms, capabilities, and insights deliver measurable impact across the resort. You will lead the design and implementation of scalable data architectures, oversee advanced analytics initiatives, and evaluate and deploy AI\-driven solutions that enhance decision\-making and operational efficiency.
   

  

 Working closely with senior leadership and business stakeholders, you will translate complex technical capabilities into clear business value, while establishing robust governance, security, and data management practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the development and execution of enterprise data and AI strategy across all business functions
* Oversee data architecture, data pipelines, and analytics platforms, ensuring scalability and integrity
* Identify and implement AI and machine learning use cases that enhance guest experience, revenue, and operational performance
* Evaluate and onboard AI platforms, tools, and vendors, ensuring alignment with business and IT strategy
* Drive end\-to\-end delivery of AI solutions, from proof of concept through to production and adoption
* Establish KPIs and success metrics to measure ROI and impact of data and AI initiatives
* Create compelling dashboards, visualisations, and data narratives for senior leadership
* Foster a culture of innovation, experimentation, and continuous improvement across IT and business teams


**About You**
 You are a senior data and technology leader with a strong blend of technical expertise and commercial acumen. You bring deep experience in data engineering, analytics, and enterprise platforms, alongside a proven ability to translate data into meaningful business outcomes.
   

  

* Strong expertise in data warehousing, data pipelines, and analytics
* Solid understanding of AI/ML concepts, including predictive models and emerging technologies such as LLMs
* Experience with cloud and AI platforms (e.g. Azure, AWS, or similar) and system integrations
* Proven track record of delivering enterprise\-scale data or AI initiatives
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience engaging senior leadership
* Ability to lead cross\-functional teams and drive transformation in complex environments


 We offer a competitive, tax\-free salary paid in UAE Dirhams (AED), alongside a wealth of benefits. These include generous food and beverage privileges, exclusive discounted rates at all Kerzner properties worldwide, comprehensive health insurance (with dental coverage), annual flights home, life insurance, an incentive programme, and a variety of colleague wellness and social initiatives.
   

  

 With a strong emphasis on learning and development, colleagues at Atlantis enjoy access to world\-class training, career mobility, and internal growth opportunities across the Kerzner portfolio \- making this an ideal environment for ambitious individuals seeking a long\-term, fulfilling career in luxury hospitality. Join the A\-Team and discover the extraordinary.

**Job Description**
 The Medical Affairs Director provides medical and scientific leadership in glomerular diseases therapy area (IgAN) within GCC. This role will work closely with a cross\-functional group to ensure that scientific and medical strategies are aligned with broader corporate and key stakeholder needs and will ensure the flawless execution of the country medical plans, with a primary focus on KSA.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Critically interprets scientific data and determines the potential impact of new research on scientific and medical understanding of assigned portfolio
* Shares country/regional insights with global teams to ensure global medical strategies and activities reflect the needs of the country/region
* Provides fair and balanced medical information and education to health care professionals and payers that support the safe and effective use of Vertex medications in the appropriate patients
* Fosters patient access to Vertex medications, by supporting the commercial organization in the preparation/review of reimbursement dossiers and presenting scientific data as required to key stake holders
* Performs/oversees medical/scientific training for field medical teams, commercial, and other internal stakeholders as required
* Contributes to the local Brand Team, representing the therapy area scientific and medical expertise and ensuring all activities address patient well\-being and respect data integrity
* Ensures compliance at country level with company policies, medical affairs SOPs, GCP and ICH
* Assesses local promotional materials and ensures that all claims are fully supported by scientific data, and are presented in an accurate, fair and balanced manner


**Key Requirements**
* Strong understanding of Nephrology (Kidney disease)
* Experience in writing or reviewing scientific communications
* Good understanding of the pharmaceutical industry International setting
* Ability to develop relationships in a highly matrixed environment, as well as external relationships with leaders and industry experts
* Experience in designing, planning medical strategies and executing medical education and communication activities
* Strong understanding of statistical methods
* Ability to engage in positive dialogue and resolve conflicts in a constructive manner
* Leadership and significant people manager experience.


**Education And Experience**
* Scientific background (e.g., Physician, PhD or PharmD)
* Minimum 10 years of medical affairs experience in multinational pharmaceutical in KSA market

 Hybrid\-Eligible Or On\-Site Eligible

 In this Hybrid\-Eligible role, you can choose to be designated as:
   

  

* Hybrid: work remotely up to two days per week; or select
* On\-Site: work five days per week on\-site with ad hoc flexibility.


 Note: The Flex status for this position is subject to Vertex’s Policy on Flex @ Vertex Program and may be changed at any time.
   

  

**Company Information**
 Vertex is a global biotechnology company that invests in scientific innovation.

 Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates an exceptional portfolio of 29 properties across 11 countries in the Middle East, Europe, and Asia. From the contemporary Maldivian island paradise at Jumeirah Olhahali Island to the art\-inspired Jumeirah Capri Palace in Italy and the modern twist on a British classic at Jumeirah Carlton Tower in London, the brand has become synonymous with warm and generous service and the ability to craft distinctive and purposeful experiences that bring joy to guests from across the world.
 



  





**About the Job** 




 As part of our continued commitment to operational excellence and leadership succession across our portfolio, we are curating a talent pool of high\-potential and experienced hospitality leaders for a
 **Director of Food \& Beverage** 
 opportunity to join
 **Jumeirah** 
 in Dubai, supporting both current and future needs.
 



 The main duties and responsibilities of this role include:
 



  




* Lead the Food \& Beverage function, reporting to the Hotel Manager, with clear vision and purpose, curating exceptional dining experiences that reflect Jumeirah’s standards of excellence
* Drive the commercial success of the operation by unlocking revenue opportunities, enhancing guest engagement, and delivering sustainable profitability across all venues
* Inspire and elevate a diverse F\&B team, cultivating a culture of passion, accountability, and continuous development that empowers colleagues to perform at their best

* Partner closely with senior leadership to align F\&B strategy with broader business objectives, ensuring agility, market relevance, and forward‑thinking decision\-making
* Champion the highest standards of quality, service, and presentation, safeguarding the brand’s reputation while creating an environment where excellence is consistently delivered



  





**About You** 




 The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:
 



  




* Extensive luxury hospitality leadership experience within internationally recognised luxury hotels, or resorts environments.
* Minimum 10 years’ operational leadership experience within Food \& Beverage Operations, with a strong track record in delivering exceptional guest experiences and operational performance.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to optimise performance, enhance efficiency, and contribute directly to sustainable business growth and profitability
* An engaging, visible leader with a hands\-on approach, fostering strong connections with teams and guests to ensure consistently elevated service standards
* Highly credible and influential professional, capable of operating within complex, fast\-paced luxury environments while maintaining brand integrity and delivering consistent results



  





**About the Benefits** 




 At Jumeirah, we are dedicated to fostering a workplace where colleagues feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow. Our benefits package reflects this commitment by combining rewarding financial incentives, comprehensive healthcare, and opportunities for professional development.

data.jd_text:
Qiddiya Investment Company is developing a leading entertainment, sports, and cultural destination in Saudi Arabia as part of the Kingdom's Vision 2030\. The organization is focused on delivering world\-class projects that require efficient and resilient supply chain and supplier relationship management, particularly in critical sectors like transport.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced Director \- Supplier Relationship Management to lead and manage supplier relationships specifically within the transport domain, overseeing supplier performance, risk, and strategic partnerships that support the organization's ambitious goals.
   

  

 The Director \- Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) is responsible for positioning TBU as a disciplined, credible and collaborative client of choice across the 30BN\+ SAR procurement pipeline. The role establishes and leads a structured SRM framework that strengthens strategic supplier engagement, improves performance transparency, manages supply chain risk and drives long\-term value across major infrastructure packages. The position plays a critical leadership role in enhancing market confidence and supporting successful procurement and delivery outcomes.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Key Responsibilities:**
* Design and implement a formal SRM framework including supplier segmentation, governance structures and executive oversight
* Lead proactive market engagement initiatives, including an annual TBU Industry Briefing to communicate pipeline visibility, procurement strategy and governance expectations
* Work closely with the Central Procurement team to ensure strong alignment, transparency and coordination across procurement to avoid duplication of effort.
* Establish and manage structured supplier performance scorecards across major contracts
* Facilitate quarterly executive\-level performance reviews with strategic suppliers
* Identify and manage strategic supply chain risks including capacity constraints, financial health, long\-lead items and concentration risk
* Collaborate with Procurement, Commercial, Risk and Project Controls to integrate supplier insights into procurement strategies and risk registers
* Drive continuous improvement through lessons learned forums, innovation workshops and structured performance improvement plans
* Provide market intelligence to inform sourcing strategies and long\-lead procurement planning
* Support dispute avoidance through early intervention and structured supplier engagement
* Develop executive dashboards providing visibility of supplier performance trends and systemic risk themes


**Leadership \& Stakeholder Management**
* Act as the executive interface between TBU and strategic suppliers
* Partner with Project Directors and Procurement leads on major package delivery
* Engage with industry bodies and supply chain partners to enhance TBU's reputation
* Provide clear and structured reporting to the Executive Director DMO and senior leadership


**Qualifications and Experience:**
* Degree in Commerce, Engineering, Business, Law or related discipline
* 15\+ years' experience in supplier relationship management, commercial leadership or major procurement environments
* Experience managing strategic supplier portfolios in large\-scale infrastructure programs
* Strong understanding of procurement governance and contract performance management
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and industry leaders
* Experience delivering structured industry engagement initiatives


**Key Competencies**
* Strategic market engagement
* Executive communication and negotiation
* Performance management and governance
* Risk identification and mitigation
* Relationship building and influencing
* Data\-driven reporting and insight generation
* Commercial acumen and integrity


**Success Measures**
* Formal SRM framework implemented across TBU
* Annual Industry Briefing successfully delivered
* Improved supplier performance metrics across major packages
* Reduction in repeat performance issues
* Enhanced market confidence and competitive tension in procurements


**Benefits**
 Comprehensive benefits package

data.jd_text:
**Director of Marketing \& Business Development – Health, Wellness** 




**Relocation to Chiang Mai, Thailand** 




**$100,000 \+ Negotiable based on experience** 




**Seeking candidates with experience of driving medical tourism** 




  





**The Organisation** 




  





 This is a rare opportunity to join one of Asia's most established and respected residential rehabilitation groups — an organisation with a 10 year\+ heritage of transforming lives, treating thousands of clients from more than 20 countries, and building a reputation as the premium destination of choice for individuals seeking discreet, high\-quality addiction and mental health care.
 



  





 The business operates a flagship 30\-bed residential site and has recently expanded into Europe with a specialist 10\-bed programme — reflecting an ambitious international growth agenda under the leadership of a highly experienced CEO with a background in world\-class medical tourism operations.
 



  





 The model is built on medical tourism: clients travel from the UK, Australia, the Middle East, Singapore, the Netherlands, the US, and Canada to access a programme that delivers demonstrably better outcomes at approximately 40% of the cost of comparable UK providers — with private rooms, comprehensive clinical programming, and a destination environment that facilitates genuine recovery.
 



  





 The business is profitable, growing, and entering its most commercially ambitious phase to date. This hire is central to that next chapter.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 The Director of Marketing and Business Development is a senior, commercially critical appointment reporting directly to the CEO. You will own the full growth engine of the business — leading both the Sales (Admissions \& Strategic Partnerships) and Marketing (Digital, Content \& Brand) functions, and driving high\-quality client acquisition across the group's international markets.
 



  





 You will inherit a talented, technically capable four\-person marketing team based in Thailand, supported by a specialist external SEO agency. Your role is to lead, elevate, and execute — bringing strategic rigour, digital expertise, and commercial edge to a business that has earned its reputation through exceptional clinical outcomes and now needs to accelerate its market presence.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Sales \& Revenue Growth** 



* Own and deliver revenue performance across all markets and service lines
* Lead the Admissions function to ensure a seamless, high\-conversion client journey
* Expand the international referral network — outpatient centres, clinicians, concierge providers, and wellness operators
* Develop targeted growth strategies across the UK, Australia, Asia, Middle East, and US
* Represent the organisation at international forums and industry events



  





**Marketing \& Digital Acquisition** 



* Lead the internal marketing team and external agency partners
* Drive performance across online search, AI\-driven discovery platforms, SEO, and digital channels
* Own the content strategy across all pillars: search, social media, LinkedIn, referrals, and thought leadership
* Improve visibility on AI discovery platforms where the business is currently underrepresented
* Maintain rigorous oversight of ROI, attribution, and brand integrity



  





**Brand \& Thought Leadership** 



* Elevate the organisation's reputation as a recognised authority in addiction treatment and mental health care
* Lead content creation that reflects the business's evolution toward holistic, nervous system\-informed, mental health\-integrated approaches
* Ensure a consistent, premium brand voice across all touchpoints and markets
* Strengthen trust through PR, media, strategic partnerships, and expert positioning



  





**Who We're Looking For** 




  





 The successful candidate will be hands\-on, hungry, and commercially sharp — someone who leads by doing, not just by directing. You will be as comfortable shaping content strategy as you are reviewing conversion data or meeting a clinical referral partner.
 



  





**You will bring:** 



* Demonstrable experience leading Sales and/or Marketing functions at Director level in a healthcare, wellness, hospitality, or international services environment
* Deep expertise in digital marketing — particularly SEO, AI\-driven discovery, content strategy, and omnichannel acquisition
* Proven track record working with and holding external agency partners accountable
* Experience serving or acquiring high\-net\-worth, international, or premium client bases
* Strong people leadership — able to develop and motivate a small, technically skilled team
* Exceptional written English — essential for content oversight and brand governance given a non\-native English speaking team
* High emotional intelligence and the ability to work sensitively within a healthcare environment that includes staff and clients in recovery
* The ability to read and align to a brand's heritage, tone, and values — and build strategically from that foundation



  





**Highly desirable:** 



* Background in addiction treatment, mental health, or international patient services
* Lived recovery experience — genuinely valued, not required
* Prior experience living or working in Asia, or demonstrable international living experience
* Familiarity with medical tourism as a business model and client acquisition channel



  





**The Package \& Location** 




  





**Compensation \& Benefits** 



* Base salary: \~$100,000 USD per annum
* 25 days combined annual leave
* Relocation flights to Thailand covered
* Temporary housing provided on arrival (2–4 weeks)
* Visa sponsorship and application support provided
* Results\-focused role — effectiveness prioritised over hours



**Why Chiang Mai?** 



* Low cost of living — $100k USD goes significantly further than UK equivalent
* Lower Thai income tax rates — take\-home substantially higher than UK
* Vibrant international expat community and thriving lifestyle
* World\-class food, culture, and outdoor environment
* Direct flights to Bangkok (1 hour, multiple daily); Bangkok is 12 hours from London



  





  





**To Apply** 




  





 To be considered for this role, in the first instance contact scousins@compassltd.co.uk with a detailed CV. Please note we will only consider candidates with direct experience of driving referrals from an international patient/customer base

**Director, Tax Transaction Advisory Services. Location \- Saudi Arabia**
 As specialists in the investment management sector, our Transaction Tax Advisory team has a broad range of experience tackling complex tax issues that span jurisdictions and tax codes. We offer a broad range of transaction tax advisory services that evolve as client needs develop. We provide expert tax advice to our clients, working collaboratively with legal counsel and local specialists where required.
   

  

 We offer you the opportunity to advance your business development skills as well as manage your own portfolio of clients seeking advice, within a work environment that offers variety and is challenging and rewarding. This is a technical, client facing role with the potential to hone a specialist field of technical knowledge and expertise is available.
   

  

**Day To Day Responsibilities**
* Have technical and commercial oversight on tax matters within tax and Zakat due diligence projects for buy\-side and sell\-side transaction projects in Saudi Arabia and the wider MENA region
* Advise on pre\-acquisition and post\-acquisition tax structuring and other deal related matters e.g. tax input into legal documents and financial models
* Provide a range of inbound and outbound tax and Zakat advisory services, helping multinational companies and investors align their tax and Zakat strategies to their business
* Provide international and domestic tax / Zakat structuring and planning for clients in Saudi Arabia and the wider MENA region
* Oversee advice on international tax issues including earnings repatriation, tax credit planning, cross\-border mergers, financing, intangibles planning and worldwide tax management strategies
* Act as a primary senior point of contact within the practice for clients in Saudi Arabia, responding to queries, anticipating requests, and maintaining regular contact with clients
* Undertake highly technical tax and Zakat advisory projects with managing director support and guidance
* Be responsible for coaching, mentoring and counselling junior staff
* Develop a professional network proactively seeking and identifying new business opportunities that drives workflow to the group
* Work as part of a collaborative team adding to the team spirit


**Essential Traits**
* Successfully completed an economics degree with a focus on accounting, auditing and/or taxes (or equivalent)
* 9\+ years’ of tax / transactions experience, including recent experience in Saudi Arabia and the wider MENA region
* Good understanding of the structure of, private equity and sovereign wealth funds. Ideally has advised funds, corporates or government entities on all matters across the investment lifecycle
* Awareness of other relevant taxes within the MENA region e.g. VAT, RETT, Customs, Social Security etc.
* Knowledge of the international tax environment and recent developments within the wider MENA region
* Proven expertise in tax and zakat matters and project oversight and management skills
* A strong work ethic and focus on personal excellence
* Ability to provide leadership and direction to team members
* Must be able to work productively in a high pressure environment and meet deadlines
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills including the ability to communicate complex tax issues with non\-tax persons (e.g. deal teams, legal counsel)
* Must be able to manage several simultaneous work streams and projects.

General Information
   

  

**Ref \#** 
 2600007Z
   

  

**Location:** 
 Qatar\-Doha
   

  

**Job family:** 
 Corporate \& Commercial
   

  

**Closing Date:** 
 2026\-07\-31
   

  

**Description**
 At Qatar Airways, we craft cutting\- edge inflight products, enhance passenger comfort, and drive innovation in aviation design. From concept to launch, our Product Development and Design (PDD) Team collaborates with industry leaders to create products that set new standards in travel.
   

  

 If you are passionate about innovation and design, this is your chance to make a lasting impact in the aviation industry.
   

  

 Join our Product Development and Design Team that transforms ideas into reality and shape the future of airline experiences!
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Senior Manager, Research and Strategy, you will be the analytical and strategic core of the Research and Strategy function within Qatar Airways' Product Development and Design division, reporting to the VP, Strategy and Planning. You will lead the delivery of research, insight, and strategic analysis that underpins the division's ability to make informed, commercially sound decisions across its full product portfolio.
   

  

 You will manage a team of researchers and analysts, building their capability and ensuring the function delivers rigorous, actionable intelligence that directly supports product investment decisions, roadmap planning, and divisional performance. You will be the person who turns ambiguous strategic questions into structured analytical frameworks, and raw data into compelling, decision\-ready recommendations.
   

  

 Working in close partnership with the Manager, Project Strategy and Planning, you will ensure that strategic insight and PMO execution are tightly connected. You will provide the research and analytical foundation that governs how initiatives are prioritised, sequenced, and measured. Your influence on governance and planning will be through the quality and clarity of the strategic input you provide, not through direct ownership of PMO processes.
   

  

 This role requires someone who is equally strong in analytical rigour and people leadership. You will need to manage the detail without losing sight of the bigger picture, and thrive in a complex, fast\-moving environment where the quality of insight directly shapes the quality of the product experience for millions of passengers.
   

  

 As part of your role, your responsibilities will be inclusive of, but not limited to the following:
   

  

**Research, Insight and Analysis**
* Lead the delivery of passenger research, market intelligence, and competitive benchmarking programmes that provide the division with a current, accurate, and actionable picture of the external landscape.
* Synthesise complex, multi\-source data into clear strategic narratives and decision\-ready recommendations for senior leadership
* Develop and maintain research frameworks and insight methodologies that ensure consistency, rigour, and relevance across all analytical outputs
* Commission and manage external research agencies and insight partners, ensuring quality, timeliness, and value for money


 Strategic Planning and Support
   

  

* Support the VP in the development and ongoing evolution of the divisional strategy, translating strategic direction into structured workplans, analytical frameworks, and clearly defined priorities for the team
* Develop and maintain product and experience strategy documents, ensuring they are current, evidence\-based, and aligned with group strategy
* Prepare high\-quality strategic materials, briefing papers, and executive presentations that enable the VP and divisional leadership to engage confidently at board and C\-suite level
* Support the evaluation and prioritisation of product initiatives, developing business cases and ROI analyses that inform investment decisions


 PMO Alignment and Strategic Influence
   

  

* Partner closely with the Manager, Project Strategy and Planning to ensure strategic priorities are accurately translated into project governance, roadmap sequencing, and performance frameworks
* Provide the analytical and strategic input that enables the PMO function to prioritise initiatives with confidence and commercial clarity
* Preview and challenge roadmap progress from a strategic perspective, escalating where initiatives are drifting from their original strategic intent or where emerging insight suggests reprioritisation is warranted
* Ensure that research and insight outputs are structured and communicated in a way that is directly usable by the PMO function, bridging the gap between strategic analysis and operational planning


 Organisational Development Support
   

  

* Support the VP in shaping ways of working improvements and operating model evolution across the division, contributing a research and insight perspective to how the division structures and sequences its work
* Help build a culture of evidence\-based decision\-making across the division by promoting best practice use of data, research, and strategic frameworks at team level
* Collaborate with the Manager, Project Strategy and Planning on the people and process dimensions of organisational change, providing strategic context and insight to support effective adoption


 Team Leadership
   

  

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of researchers and analysts, setting clear expectations, managing performance, and creating a working environment where talent grows and thrives
* Build team capability in research methodology, strategic analysis, and structured communication, raising the quality and impact of the function's outputs over time
* Foster a team culture defined by intellectual curiosity, attention to detail, and a genuine commitment to delivering insight that makes a difference


 Be part of an extraordinary story
   

  

 Your skills. Your imagination. Your ambition. Here, there are no boundaries to your potential and the impact you can make. You’ll find infinite opportunities to grow and work on the biggest, most rewarding challenges that will build your skills and experience. You have the chance to be a part of our future and build the life you want while being part of an international community.
   

  

 Our best is here and still to come. To us, impossible is only a challenge. Join us as we dare to achieve what’s never been done before.
   

  

 Together, everything is possible.
   

  

 Qualification
   

  

**About You**
 To be successful in this role, you should have:
   

  

 Bachelor's Degree or equivalent with a minimum of 10 years of experience in research, strategy, insight, or planning. A postgraduate qualification in business, strategy, or a related discipline is advantageous.
   

  

**Essential**
